levels.surface: أبي الجوزاء المنبه بن عبد الله

notes: Rule 11: al-Faqih's statement of his routes («طرق») to a book, with no saying: needs a ruling
Route 1 is written with the author first («ما كان فيه عن أبي الجوزاء ... رويته عن أبي»); the levels follow the compiler's shaykh (his father) first, the book's author last
«رضي اللّه عنهما» and «رحمه اللّه» are stripped; the last name of each route is the book's author, not decided here
